# 入楞伽經

**ID:** T0671
**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 元魏 菩提流支譯
**Dynasty:** 元魏
**Date:** 513
**Juans:** 10
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0671

## Contributors
- 菩提流支 (A001357)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T671 in ten fascicles is the second Chinese translation of the *Laṅkāvatāra-sūtra*, produced at the Northern Wèi capital Luòyáng. Compared with the four-fascicle [T670](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) of [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) of 443, T671 is roughly two-and-a-half times longer and reflects a fuller recension of the Indic source — including the chapter-internal apparatus (formal openings of dialogue, summary verses) and the long *Sagāthaka* verse-appendix that the Sanskrit also preserves.

**Abstract**

The translation is unanimously ascribed to [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) (Bodhiruci, d. c. 527) on the basis of the *Lìdài sānbǎo jì*, the *Kāiyuán shìjiào lù*, and the *Xù gāosēng zhuàn*. The date is fixed by the *Lìdài sānbǎo jì* at Yánchāng 延昌 2 (= 513), at the Yǒngníngsì 永寧寺 in Luòyáng. The translation team included the Wèi imperial supervisor Yuányú 元預, the *zhōngshūlìng* Lǐzhōng 李崇, and the bilingual ʿverbal-renderer' (*chuányǔ* 傳語) Sēnglǎng 僧朗.

T671 was the principal *Laṅkāvatāra* used in Northern Wèi Yogācāra circles and was the version commented upon by [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) in his *Rù Léngqiéxīn xuányì* ([T1790](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0333)). For Chinese Chán transmission [T670](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (Guṇabhadra) eventually displaced it, but T671 remained the philologically more useful witness for understanding the underlying Sanskrit recension. Its inclusion of the *Sagāthaka* makes it the only complete Chinese rendering of the sūtra.
